text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Trainy-poo~♡
What's the schedule look like
for tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I have a favor to ask. Um, you see...
Will you come to the pool with me?
choice_data_list: Even with the ocean right there?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, a pool near the ocean
feels totally like a celebrity getaway, right?☆
Come on, come on! Wouldn't it be great?"
Restlessly fidgeting, Vivlos begs me to go right away.

She seems to be having quite a lot of fun.
She's been working hard in training, so taking a breather
isn't a bad thing at all.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
! Yay~!
Let's play lots and lots, Trainy☆

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Aaaand...
no looking at other girls when we're at the pool, okay?
You have to focus only on me♡

—Keeping my promise with Vivlos,
I came to the pool.
She told me to go ahead, and as I was waiting...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ta-da☆

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. How is it? How do I look??
It's a swimsuit made just for me, and only me♡

"...I see.
So this was why you were so excited.
You wanted to show off your new swimsuit, didn't you?"

It's not overly flashy, perfectly blending
cuteness with elegance—it suits her to a tee.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... I'm happy to hear that, but
maybe sweeten the deal a little more~?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ah! Jeez, Trainy! If you're gonna think, look at me properly while you do it!
choice_data_list: Even if you tell me that...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Come on, pretty please♡
I've been looking forward
to hearing what you'd say, you know.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Come on, is there anything?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Geez. You're hopeless~.
Just think about it by the time we head back, okay?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'm not leaving until I'm satisfied with your answer.
So be prepared, okay~? Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's play a whole bunch today!
First, what do you wanna do~?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
A swim ring! Floating around without having to swim
almost makes me feel like a celebrity... maybe?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, let's go!
Looks like we can use the big swim rings over in that area!

I walked through the pool for a while, pulling along the swim ring
Vivlos was riding on. As expected, fatigue started to set in,
so we took a break, but—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Even though all we did was float, that was so fun~♡
Thanks, Trainy.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. In that case, it's Trainer-chi's turn
to kick back and relax next, huh?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's go one more time.
This time I'll lead the way♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
There's no point if we can't enjoy it together, after all.

I spent the entire day having a blast with Vivlos.
Just as we were talking about heading home soon...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: That sounds nice. Looks like we can skate as a pair...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I wonder how fast it can go?
I'm so excited!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Haaah~♡ This is so fun, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I didn't get as much speed as I thought I would, but maybe if I tweak my body angle a bit more, I can go faster?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Let's try out all sorts of things☆
choice_data_list: Ah, just make sure not to do anything dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yeah, of course!

I spent the entire day having a blast with Vivlos.
Just as we were talking about heading home soon...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah—! Trainy, did you forget?
You can't go home until you answer that question!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
You were watching closely without looking away, right?
I asked you to focus on me, after all, didn't I?

"Oh, that's right..." I thought,
staring intently at her face as I reconsidered.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
! ...J-Jeez, Trainer-chi.
You're supposed to look at the swimsuit, not my face!
As Vibros squirmed shyly, her swimsuit fluttered softly. Somehow, it felt just like the girl standing before me today.

"Playing, laughing, and frolicking to our hearts' content.
It was truly—"

It might have been an odd reaction to clothes,
but that's truly what I felt.
...And then—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! Exactly!
It's so cute and exciting, it just makes you wanna invite everyone to play, right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Train-y!
You really get—

That was my fresh impression of her.
Vivlos paused for a moment, then spoke
as if holding back a smile playing at her lips.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
*A-Ahem*.
Honestly, I want you to praise me waaaay more, but I'll save that for next time.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
And also!
I invited you this time, Trainy, but next time...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yeah! Make sure to invite me lots♡
We have to go all over the place and enjoy summer to the fullest!
